```{r}
cpg_anno <- all_results_betas_annotated[["IMvsNormalAntrum"]][, c("Row.names","UCSC_RefGene_Name","UCSC_RefGene_Accession","UCSC_RefGene_Group","Phantom5_Enhancers","DMR","X450k_Enhancer","Regulatory_Feature_Group","GencodeCompV12_NAME","GencodeCompV12_Accession","GencodeCompV12_Group","DNase_Hypersensitivity_NAME","DNase_Hypersensitivity_Evidence_Count","OpenChromatin_NAME","OpenChromatin_Evidence_Count","TFBS_NAME","TFBS_Evidence_Count")]

genes_split <- strsplit(cpg_anno$UCSC_RefGene_Name, ";")
site_split <- strsplit(cpg_anno$UCSC_RefGene_Group, ";")
gc <- S4Vectors::elementNROWS(genes_split)
is_gene <- (gc > 0)

cpg_anno_ts <- data.table(cpg_id = rep(cpg_anno$Row.names[is_gene], times=gc[is_gene]), gene = unlist(genes_split[is_gene]), site = unlist(site_split[is_gene]), key="cpg_id") 
cpg_anno_ts <- unique(cpg_anno_ts)
```

```{r}
gsea_gmt_folder = "../../../../Data/ExtData/genesets/MSigDB/msigdb_v2023.2.Hs_GMTs"
#gsea_gmt_files = paste0(c("h.all.", "c2.all.","c3.all.","c5.go.bp.","c6.all.","c7.all."), "v2023.2.Hs.symbols.gmt")
gsea_gmt_files = paste0(c("h.all.", "c2.all.","c3.all.","c5.go.bp.","c6.all."), "v2023.2.Hs.symbols.gmt")

#names(gsea_gmt_files) = c("HALLMARK","PATHWAYS","MOTIF","GO_BP","ONCOGENIC","IMMUNOLOGIC")
names(gsea_gmt_files) = c("HALLMARK","PATHWAYS","MOTIF","GO_BP","ONCOGENIC")
gset_collections_human = list()
for (n in names(gsea_gmt_files)) {
  gset_collections_human[[n]] = gmtPathways(file.path(gsea_gmt_folder, gsea_gmt_files[[n]]) )
}

```


```{r}
test_fisher_enr <- function(query, gene_set, universe) {
  # 0 = -/-, 1 = +/-, 2=-/+, 3=+/+
  a1 <- universe %in% gene_set
  a2 <- universe %in% query
  d <- (a1 + a2*2) |> factor(levels=as.character(0:3))
  dm <- table(d) |> matrix(2,2)
  dmp <- dm/(sum(dm))
  or = (dmp[1,1]*dmp[2,2])/(dmp[1,2]*dmp[2,1])
  r <- fisher.test(dm)
  tmp <- table(d) |> as.numeric()
  names(tmp) <- c("d","c","b","support")
  tmp["gs_size"] = tmp["support"] + tmp["c"]
  return(c(pval = r$p.value, OR_MLE = as.numeric(r$estimate), OR = or,  tmp ))
}
library(compiler)
test_fisher_enr_f <- compiler::cmpfun(test_fisher_enr)
```


```{r, eval=FALSE}
# test enrichment algorithm
set.seed(1234)

universe_dge <- unique(cpg_anno_ts$gene)

gset_lengths_msigdb <- do.call(c, gset_collections_human) |> sapply(length)

# simulate random gene set collection with same total number and lengths drawn from the MSigDB gene set lengths

n_total <- length(gset_lengths_msigdb)
sim_lengths <- sample(gset_lengths_msigdb, n_total, replace=T)
#names(sim_lengths) <- paste0("GS_", 1:length(sim_lengths))

sim_gsets <- Map(function(len) { sample(universe_dge, len) }, sim_lengths)

query = sample(universe_dge, 800)

rr <- Map(function(x) {test_fisher_enr_f(query, x, universe_dge)}, sim_gsets) |> do.call(rbind, args=_) |> as.data.frame()
rr$gs_name <- rownames(rr)
rr$padj <- p.adjust(rr$pval, "BH")
rr$logOR <- log(rr$OR)

median_logOR = median(subset(rr, !is.infinite(logOR))$logOR)
hist(rr$logOR, 100, sub=paste0("Mean logOR=", prettyNum(median_logOR, digits=3)) )
abline(v=0, lty=2)
abline(v=median_logOR, col="red", lwd=2)

rr$gs_size = rr$support + rr$c
rr$gs_bin <- cut(rr$gs_size, c(seq(0,200, 10), 5000) )
with(subset(rr, !is.infinite(logOR)), boxplot(logOR ~ gs_bin, las=2, main="LogOR distribution by gene set size" ) )
abline(h=0, lty=2)

```

Simulation results show that gene sets with less than around 20 genes have logOR values strongly biased towards higher values. This does not necessarily need to lower adjusted p-values, but should be considered when filtering results. 


# Enrichment of DM genes in functional / genomic categories


```{r}
all_enrichment_results <- list()
```


## All genes

We use |log2FC| > 0.2 and FDR < 5% as thresholds to select hyper- and hypomethylated CpGs. CpGs mapping to all possible gene sites (5 prime / TSS, body, 3 prime) are included. 

```{r}
tmp = all_results_betas_annotated[["IMvsNormalAntrum"]]
hyper_cpg_sel = subset(tmp, logFC > 0.20 & adj.P.Val < 0.05)
hyper_genes_sel = unique(unlist(strsplit(hyper_cpg_sel$UCSC_RefGene_Name, ";")))

hypo_cpg_sel = subset(tmp, logFC < -0.2 & adj.P.Val < 0.05)
hypo_genes_sel = unique(unlist(strsplit(hypo_cpg_sel$UCSC_RefGene_Name, ";")))
```


We identified `r length(hyper_genes_sel)` hypermethylated and `r length(hypo_genes_sel)` hypomethylated genes. 

### Hypermethylated genes

```{r}
universe_dge <- unique(cpg_anno_ts$gene)
query = hyper_genes_sel

all_res <- list()
for (n in names(gset_collections_human)) {
  rr <- Map(function(x) {test_fisher_enr_f(query, x, universe_dge)}, gset_collections_human[[n]]) |> do.call(rbind, args=_) |> as.data.frame()
  rr$gs_name <- rownames(rr)
  rr$collection <- n
  all_res[[n]] <- rr
}

enrichment_hyper <- do.call(rbind, all_res)
enrichment_hyper$padj <- p.adjust(enrichment_hyper$pval, "BH")
enrichment_hyper$logOR <- log(enrichment_hyper$OR)

all_enrichment_results[["hyperm_all_gene_sites"]] <- enrichment_hyper
```

```{r}
hist(enrichment_hyper$padj, 100, main="Adj. p-value")
hist(enrichment_hyper$logOR, 100, main = "log OR")
```


```{r, fig.width=7, fig.height=10}
tmp <- subset(enrichment_hyper, padj < 0.05 & support > 5 & !grepl("^MIR|_MIR[0-9]", gs_name))
tmp <- tmp[order(tmp$OR, decreasing = T), ]
tmp$rank_down <- rank(tmp$OR)
tmp$rank_up <- nrow(tmp)-rank(tmp$OR)+1

tmp2 <- subset(tmp, rank_up < 30 | rank_down < 30)
par(mar=c(5,14,4,1))
barplot(tmp2$logOR, names.arg = tmp2$gs_name, las=2, cex.names = .5, horiz = T, xlab="log(OR)", main="Gene sets with FDR < 5% and support > 5 genes, top 30 up/down")
abline(v=0)
```

## Genes mapping to CpG in 5'UTR or TSS/first exon

We use |log2FC| > 0.2 and FDR < 5% as thresholds to select hyper- and hypomethylated CpGs. CpGs mapping gene sites 5 prime / TSS or first exon are included. 

```{r}
tmp = all_results_betas_annotated[["IMvsNormalAntrum"]]
hyper_cpg_sel = subset(tmp, logFC > 0.20 & adj.P.Val < 0.05)
hyper_sites <- cpg_anno_ts[hyper_cpg_sel$Row.names]
hyper_genes_sel = unique(subset(hyper_sites, site %in% c("5'UTR","TSS1500","TSS200","1stExon"))$gene)

hypo_cpg_sel = subset(tmp, logFC < -0.2 & adj.P.Val < 0.05)
hypo_sites <- cpg_anno_ts[hypo_cpg_sel$Row.names]
hypo_genes_sel = unique(subset(hypo_sites, site %in% c("5'UTR","TSS1500","TSS200","1stExon"))$gene)

```


We identified `r length(hyper_genes_sel)` hypermethylated and `r length(hypo_genes_sel)` hypomethylated genes.
